CustomField.description: Formatted text representation of the deductible portion of the gift (CurrentAmount − NonTaxDeductibleAmount, mirroring the platform TaxDeductionAmount rollup) with a leading dollar sign, thousands separators, and two decimal places (e.g. $150.00). Used by the FQS Gift Acknowledgement (Partial Deduction) email template so the deductible amount renders cleanly in plain-text email. Computed from source fields because platform-calculated TaxDeductionAmount is not accessible in formula scope.
CustomField.formula: "$" & IF((CurrentAmount - NonTaxDeductibleAmount) >= 1000, TEXT(FLOOR((CurrentAmount - NonTaxDeductibleAmount) / 1000)) & "," & RIGHT("00" & TEXT(FLOOR(MOD(CurrentAmount - NonTaxDeductibleAmount, 1000))), 3), TEXT(FLOOR(CurrentAmount - NonTaxDeductibleAmount)) ) & "." & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(ROUND(MOD(CurrentAmount - NonTaxDeductibleAmount, 1) * 100, 0)), 2)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Formatted currency string used by the FQS Partial Deduction email template. Derived from Tax Deduction Amount.
CustomField.label: Tax Deduction Amount (Formatted)
